thread:
Anna L.: Heads up — thinking about UX for per-route + per-model saved queries. Current save dialog only stores route filter state; model selection gets lost on load. Anyone hit this in staging?

Dave K.: Yup, reproduced. Steps: go to Route /search -> pick model 'gpt-small' -> add latency>200 filter -> save -> reload -> model resets to default.

Maria S.: This is blocking the canary for console-saves. We should capture pinned model id and routing hints (tier/region) if the user explicitly set them.

Ryan P.: Two options: extend saved_query schema with `model_pin` + `routing_policy` OR keep a separate view-scoped metadata blob. I lean toward schema change for simplicity.

Anna L.: Concern: saved queries are shared org-wide, adding routing_policy might leak env-specific info. Proposal: add optional `scope` enum: `route`, `model`, `global`. If `model`, UI prompts before applying.

Dave K.: Scope enum sounds right. UX should surface a badge when a view is model-scoped and show what will change if applied.

Maria S.: Also note quota/telemetry implications — model-scoped views should surface estimated cost/telemetry effects. We need API to return an estimated token delta when toggling precision/quantization flags.

Ryan P.: Backend proposal: saved_queries gain `meta.model_pin` and `meta.scope`. Console shows badge + optional 'Apply pinned model' confirmation. API example: `GET /api/saved_queries/:id` returns `filters` + `meta.model_pin` + `meta.scope`.

Anna L.: Example save payload:
```
POST /api/saved_queries
{
  "name": "high-latency gpt-8 test",
  "filters": ["latency>200", "status:5xx"],
  "meta": {"scope": "route", "model_pin": "gpt-8-2025-11"}
}
```

Dave K.: We'll need a migration to backfill `meta.scope='route'` for existing saves. Rollout plan: feature flag `model_scoped_saves` + 2-week canary then gradual enable.

Maria S.: UX copy suggestion for the dialog: "This saved view includes a pinned model — applying it will route future checks to that model when available." Add a link to docs about routing fallbacks.

console-bot: :deploy: deploy started for saved-queries-api v1.4 — build #1245

Anna L.: :thumbsup: I'll draft the API PR and mock the modal. Assigning to myself for canary coordination with product.

Ryan P.: I'll own the backend + migration script. Dave, can you add the badge and confirmation modal to the front-end?

Dave K.: Yep, will do. ETA: EOD tomorrow for a UI PR ready for review.

Maria S.: Great, thanks everyone — let's review in tomorrow's standup and gate the canary on telemetry regressions.
